purpose: Check whether selected external-review proposals are scientifically plausible research candidates before any Keirin-specific adoption.

verified_public_literature.source: Angelopoulos and Bates, A Gentle Introduction to Conformal Prediction and Distribution-Free Uncertainty Quantification, arXiv:2107.07511
verified_public_literature.finding: Conformal methods provide prediction sets/intervals with formal coverage properties under their stated assumptions and can wrap black-box predictors; extensions exist for structured outputs, shift, and time-series settings.

verified_public_literature.source: Gibbs and Candes, Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Distribution Shift, arXiv:2106.00170
verified_public_literature.finding: Adaptive conformal methods explicitly address changing distributions in online settings, so chronological drift is a material design consideration rather than something ordinary exchangeable conformal can ignore.

verified_public_literature.source: Zaffran et al., Adaptive Conformal Predictions for Time Series, arXiv:2202.07282
verified_public_literature.finding: Time-series dependence complicates ordinary exchangeability assumptions and motivates adaptive procedures; validity/efficiency must be assessed for the actual temporal process.

verified_public_literature.source: Battaglia et al., Relational inductive biases, deep learning, and graph networks, arXiv:1806.01261
verified_public_literature.finding: Graph networks are a principled way to encode entities and relationships. Rider-as-node and line/position relation-as-edge is therefore structurally plausible, but the paper does not establish predictive superiority for Keirin.

decisions.conformal: retain as uncertainty research candidate; do not adopt until ordered-top3 probability-object compatibility and temporal-validity assumptions are tested
decisions.GNN: retain as representation prototype; compare on the same strict temporal evaluator against market, score, tabular, C0, C1, and N1
decisions.causal_ML_double_ML: not verified in this note; remains VERIFY_BEFORE_ADOPTION
decisions.multi_agent_RL_offline_RL: not verified in this note; remains VERIFY_BEFORE_ADOPTION

anti_overclaim: literature plausibility is not Keirin signal evidence
method sophistication is not a promotion criterion
GNN relational fit does not imply GNN beats tabular
conformal coverage claims depend on method assumptions and temporal setting
